args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy. Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0 (deployed 2024-06-01, seq 1). Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate reduced from 18% to 0.2%. v2.3.1-rc (staging) was also unhealthy, suggesting the issue was present pre-production. Follow-up required: root-cause the v2.3.1 failure and obtain change-manager approval before any redeploy of a fix, since v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back:** checkout-api rolled back in all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release with a healthy production status. Verified healthy post-rollout — error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Incident opened:** **INC-0001** (SEV2), "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0" — on-call engineer paged, with full details of the failure and rollback.

Note for follow-up: v2.3.1 (and its staging pre-release v2.3.1-rc) were never healthy, so any redeploy of a fixed version will require change-manager approval before it can ship.
